fields.converged_cv: continuous CV of the first-passage time (no hazard, no censoring)
fields.binned_cv_at_delta: CV of the recorded outcome (deaths at k delta, censored at C) under the generator's law at the configuration's delta, hazard, censoring
fields.model_censored_fraction: S_obs(C): the expected censored fraction at the chosen C
fields.kl, dlncv: the sweep's (run 3) grid error, lambda = 2 n kl
